title: Schema for okf.config.json
description: Okf-wiki local configuration for agents operating on one or more OKF knowledge bundles. Lives at the project root.

systemPath.description: A system path. It can be absolute, or relative to the config file. Accepts both Windows and POSIX path syntax.

$schema.description: Optional JSON Schema reference for editor tooling.

fullIndexPosition.description: Where the recursive full index is written.

bundles.description: The knowledge bundles configured for this project.

oneOf.description: Path to a standalone bundle.config.schema.json-shaped file holding this bundle's configuration.
